paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 10.0, marked at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, also on a linear scale, spanning from 18 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays four lines, each corresponding to a different model: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (dark purple dashed line with square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at around 18.5 BLEU at an AL of 0.0, increases to approximately 26.7 at an AL of 10.0, with a notable rise between AL values of 2.5 and 5.0. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at about 19.2 BLEU at an AL of 0.0 and reaches around 27 at an AL of 10.0, showing a similar trend to Consistency-CE. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line closely follows Inconsistency-CE, starting at roughly 18.8 BLEU at an AL of 0.0 and ending at approximately 27 at an AL of 10.0. The Consistency-Bi line starts at around 22 BLEU at an AL of 0.0 and peaks at approximately 28.5 BLEU at an AL of around 8.0 before slightly decreasing to about 28.3 at an AL of 10.0.
